It is completely understandable to be worried about these sudden changes in your daughter. Her symptoms could point to a few different things. Staring off into space and being unresponsive to her name can sometimes be a medical issue, such as absence seizures, which are brief periods of lost awareness. At the same time, her shift from being outgoing to quiet and withdrawing from friends could indicate an emotional or psychological struggle, such as anxiety, depression, bullying, or a response to a stressful event. 

Because these changes are significant and involve both behavioral and potential physical symptoms, it is very important to have her evaluated by a pediatrician as soon as possible. A doctor can help rule out any medical conditions and guide you toward a child psychologist or counselor if the root cause is emotional. In the meantime, continue offering her a gentle, pressure-free environment so she knows you are there to support her whenever she is ready.
